rationale: The protected phrasing held exactly: “These differences were associated with restoration status,” preserving the noncausal strength. The modal hedge also held in “canopy effects may differ modestly.” All reported values, decimal places, confidence-interval bounds, p-values, and citations were retained unchanged. Recasting nitrate as “lower in restored plots than in unrestored plots” and oxygen as occurring “more often” faithfully expresses the same numerical descriptive contrasts. Splitting the model estimates into separate sentences and relocating details parenthetically are authorized by R-1 and R-2 and do not change substantive content.
